legal.termsMetaDescription: Terms governing your access to and use of the WeSync website and mobile app.

privacy.intro: Welcome to WeSync. Your group's privacy and data security are our highest priorities. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website and mobile application. It is intended to align with the privacy disclosures we provide in the Apple App Store.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.lead: We collect information necessary to provide group collaboration features. The categories below include the types of data we disclose in the App Store privacy nutrition labels (User Content, linked to your identity, for app functionality):

items.body: When you sign in using Sign in with Apple or Google (web console), we collect the name and email address provided by the identity provider to create and secure your account. This information is linked to your identity.

To operate core features, we process email addresses, phone numbers you optionally add to member profiles, invitation-related text, and other text you enter in tasks, feedback, or group communications. This data is linked to your account and used only for app functionality—not for advertising or cross-app tracking.

If you choose to upload a profile avatar or attach photos or videos to tasks, feedback, or related group content, we store and display that media within your group. Such content is linked to your identity and used only to provide the service.

We store collaboration data you and your group create, including task and schedule details, group names and descriptions, managed member profiles, comments, attachments metadata, and similar content. This information is linked to your account or the profiles you manage and is used only for group collaboration features.

If you create profiles for group members who do not have their own accounts (such as children or elders), you confirm that you have the right to provide their basic identifying information (such as names, nicknames, or optional contact details) for group management purposes.
We may collect non-personally identifiable information such as device type, app crash logs, and usage metrics to ensure the stability of the App. This data is not used for advertising.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.lead: We use the information described above solely for app functionality, including:

items.body: Providing, syncing, and displaying tasks, schedules, group roles, profiles, and user-generated content across authorized group members and your devices.
Authenticating your identity and enforcing access controls so only members of your group can view that group's data.
Storing and delivering photos, videos, and text you choose to share within the service.
Providing customer support, fixing errors, and improving reliability.

paragraphs: We do not use your personal data for third-party advertising, and we do not sell your data. Data identified in the App Store as linked to you is associated with your account or profile for the purposes stated above.

sections.heading: 3. Data Storage & Security
paragraphs: We utilize enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure (including Supabase) to store your data securely. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We employ strict Row-Level Security (RLS) database policies to ensure that your group data is completely isolated and only accessible to authorized members of your specific group.

sections.heading: 4. Information Sharing
paragraphs: We do not, and will never, sell your personal data to third parties. We only share information with trusted service providers (such as secure cloud hosting) strictly for the purpose of operating our service. We may also disclose information if required by law.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights and Data Deletion
paragraphs: You have full control over your data. You can edit your profile, delete specific tasks, remove attachments, or remove group members at any time within the App. You may also permanently delete your entire account and all associated user content via the account deletion options in the App's settings. Once deleted, this action is irreversible.

sections.heading: 1. Description of Service
paragraphs: WeSync is a group collaboration and productivity tool designed to help groups manage tasks, schedules, and member profiles. The service is provided "as is" and we reserve the right to modify, update, or discontinue features at our discretion.

items.body: You must provide accurate information when creating an account (e.g., via Apple ID).
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and any devices you use to access WeSync.
You must promptly notify us of any unauthorized use of your account.
When you create a "Group" within the App, you act as the Administrator.
You are solely responsible for the data you input regarding other group members, including virtual profiles created for individuals without active accounts.
You are responsible for managing who is invited to join your group and for removing members when necessary.

You retain ownership of the photos, videos, text, and other content you submit. By submitting content, you grant us a limited license to host, store, display, and transmit that content solely to operate the service for your group.
You represent that you have the necessary rights to upload and share any content you provide, including images and videos, and that doing so does not violate the privacy or rights of others.
You are responsible for the accuracy and legality of content you or your group administrators add, including contact information stored in member profiles.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable Use

items.body: Upload, post, or transmit any content that is illegal, abusive, harassing, or violates the privacy of others, including unauthorized photos or videos of other people.
Attempt to hack, disrupt, or compromise the security of the App, our servers, or our database structure.
Reproduce, duplicate, copy, or resell any part of the Service without our express written permission.
